g.text: Boundary-conditioned state aggregation (BCSA) weights each box’s mean row state by its boundary probability.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #142b39

g.text: To train across backgrounds, we take the Mamba step size for both retention and writing from the edited view.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #142b39

g.text: Both predictions are supervised with the original class and box targets.
